items.excerpt: The chat-ready weights landed on Hugging Face, with the upload dated November 23. Running them yourself is another matter: the smallest setup holds the weights on a single 288 GB Blackwell GPU.
items.title: ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview ships under Apache 2.0

items.excerpt: FreeLLMAPI lets Claude Code run on 87 free providers' tiers through one local endpoint. When one provider hits its limit, the router fails over to the next, in a pool the project marks for personal experimentation only.
items.title: Claude Code, running on free tiers

items.excerpt: Nebius AI Builder Program members get $25 in AI Cloud credits, with no credit card required, on a page that states no publication date. At Spot prices, that stretches to a B300 for an afternoon or an H100 for up to a day, according to Nebius's November 24 post.
items.title: Nebius gives $25 in GPU credits, no card required

items.excerpt: Since November 23, OpenAI has been rolling out a chat-tuned GPT-6.2 Sol to the regular Chat tab for paid ChatGPT plans. In OpenAI's own Chat-tab tests, image understanding rose from 47.4% with GPT-6 to 71.7%.
items.title: GPT-6.2 reaches ChatGPT's Chat tab, paid plans only

items.excerpt: SenseTime released SenseNova U1.6 today, an 8B unified multimodal model built for image generation and editing. The weights are on Hugging Face under the Apache 2.0 license.
items.title: SenseNova U1.6 fixes the text in its own images
